title: Restriction-compatible alternating families of module presheaves
statement: Let $(\mathcal C,J)$ be a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], let $A$ be a presheaf of commutative rings, let $P,N$ be presheaves of $A$-modules with semilinear restrictions, in the module-presheaf category underlying [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification], and let $n\in\mathbf N$. A restriction-compatible alternating family from $P$ to $N$ is a family $(b_U)_U$ of $A(U)$-multilinear alternating maps $P(U)^n\to N(U)$ [def-weil-pbc-exterior-algebra] such that $b_V(P(f)x_1,\ldots,P(f)x_n)=N(f)b_U(x_1,\ldots,x_n)$ for every $f:V\to U$ and every tuple. Alternating means zero whenever two entries are equal. For $n=0$ this is a restriction-compatible family of elements of $N(U)$.
